title: Qt: Add delta times to the follow dialog text formats
description:
When showing the follow data as text (ASCII, UTF-8, EBCDIC, etc), add a
newline at each turn along with an optional delta time.

Manually connect our signals and slots. Fix some clazy warnings.

notes.body: assigned to @geraldcombs

[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14263/diffs?diff_id=913728076&start_sha=4d0e8eb077f81cac19dbcbf39b96f8b234cdfccb)

  • 286239e7 - Qt: Add delta times to the follow dialog text formats
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14263/diffs?diff_id=913756771&start_sha=b894d62571bbed47b82331ab5b018a1e0a9c6a99)

Very useful. When I looked into the QPlainTextEdit performance, the largest performance hit is from Qt looking for word boundaries to aid in rendering. It's better with word wrap turned off, but it's still quite slow on streams that don't have any whitespace.

That was the problem on one of @desowin's files I looked at. Since the recent follow format is saved, opening as Raw is a little better since we insert newlines (that are removed when saving.)

It might be useful to (have an option to) insert newlines and possibly timestamps between each packet, not just a turn? Some streams are fairly unidirectional.
The delta checkbox could be a "none / turns / all packets" combobox instead. It would be nice to do that without the option area getting too wide and busy.
It might be nice to store its setting in `recent` too.
I switched to a combobox. It might make sense to wait for this to shake out before adding a recent setting.
The entire reason why `addPlainText` turned out to be faster than `insertPlainText` at the end was because of scanning to try to render the optimal layout.

commits_data.title: Qt: Add delta times to the follow dialog text formats
commits_data.message:
Qt: Add delta times to the follow dialog text formats

When showing the follow data as text (ASCII, UTF-8, EBCDIC, etc), add a
newline at each turn. Add the ability to show delta times between
packets and turns. Add a recent setting for delta times.

Make the initial dialog a bit wider.

Save and restore our scoll position when reading a stream.

Manually connect our signals and slots. Fix some clazy warnings.
